python3 -c "
import numpy as np, trimesh
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import _poses, _step, _sweep, _box_gap, overlap
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
names = {'wheel1': {'name':'wheel1','_mesh':w,'_solid':section.to_manifold(w)}, 'base1': {'name':'base1','_mesh':b,'_solid':section.to_manifold(b)}}
motion = {'name':'free','kind':'rotate','point':[0,0,4],'axis':[0,0,1],'range':[0,-30],'instances':['wheel1']}
print('step', _step(motion, names))
pairs = [(names['wheel1'], names['base1'])]
import math
lo,hi=-30.0,0.0
step=_step(motion,names); count=min(360,max(1,math.ceil((hi-lo)/step))); vals=np.linspace(lo,hi,count+1)
print('count',count,'n',len(vals))
poses=[(float(v),_poses(motion,float(v))) for v in vals]
print('pose at idx30', vals[30], poses[30][1]['wheel1'][:2,:])
hits=_sweep(pairs, poses)
print('hits', len(hits))
for h in hits[:20]: print(round(h['pose'],3), h['volume_mm3'], h['thickness_mm'])
"
